Indicates whether this is a simulation activity used for testing. Regular customers do not need to concern themselves with this.

Whether to keep the activity in the executing state until it expires. The default value is false. If false, the activity automatically transitions to the completed state after all contacts have been called. If true, the activity remains in the executing state even after all contacts have been called, allowing you to append additional contacts and continue dialing until the activity expires or is manually stopped.

ReleaseTime.description: The time when the call ended. This is the time when the last party of the call hangs up. The value is a UNIX timestamp, in milliseconds.

schema.description: The start time of the Historical Data to retrieve, in UNIX timestamp format with millisecond precision. This parameter is optional. The default value is 00:00:00 of the current day. The earliest allowed time is 180 days before the current time. The time precision for statistics is hourly, snapped to the previous full hour, and the interval is closed.

The end time of the Historical Data to retrieve, in UNIX timestamp format with millisecond precision. This parameter is optional. The default value is the current time. The time precision for statistics is hourly, snapped to the next full hour, and the interval is open. For example, if the start time is 11:12:20 and the end time is 11:45:50, the snapped input parameter Time Range becomes \[11:00:00, 12:00:00), meaning greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00.
Media Type. The default value is Audio. Other valid values include Chat and Video.

AverageRingTime.description: Average ring time in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged.

CallsVoicemail.description: Number of calls transferred to voicemail. The count increases by 1 when a call enters the voicemail module configured in IVR.

MaxAbandonedInIVRTime.description: Maximum IVR abandonment duration, in seconds. IVR abandonment is defined as a customer hanging up during IVR interaction. This does not include hang-ups while waiting in queue or during agent ringing after call assignment.

CallsHandled.description: Acknowledgement count, which refers to the number of calls answered by agents. If a single call is answered by multiple agents, it is counted only once.

CallsIVRException.description: Number of calls with IVR exceptions. A call is counted when the IVR enters a hang-up reason node and the hang-up reason configured in that node is "transfer to agent failed."

CallsAbandonedInIVR.description: Number of calls abandoned in IVR, which refers to the count of calls where the customer hung up during the IVR flow after entering it. This is determined by the hang-up reason in call details being marked as "IVR abandoned."

TotalHoldTime.description: Total call hold duration, in seconds.

MaxAbandonTime.description: Maximum abandon time, in seconds. A call is considered abandoned if the customer hangs up after entering the IVR but before an agent answers.

AverageAbandonTime.description: Average abandon time, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalAbandonTime / CallsAbandoned.

CallsRinged.description: Number of calls that rang agents. If a single call is assigned to multiple agents and rings, it is counted once.

CallsQueuingFailed.description: The number of queue failures, which refers to the count of calls where the customer hung up while waiting in the queue after entering it.

AbandonRate.description: Abandon rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandoned / CallsOffered (because abandonment events and assignment events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases).

MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description: Maximum ringing abandonment duration, in seconds. Ringing abandonment is defined as the customer hanging up while the call is ringing on the agent's side after being assigned to the agent.

CallsBlindTransferred.description: The number of blind transfers, which refers to the count of calls directly transferred without consultation. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one.

AverageAbandonedInIVRTime.description: Average IVR abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInIVRTime / CallsAbandonedInIVR.

AverageTalkTime.description: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsHandled.

CallsAttendedTransferred.description: Number of consultative transfers, which refers to the number of calls that were transferred via consultative transfer. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one.

TotalAbandonedInIVRTime.description: Total IVR abandonment duration, in seconds.

CallsQueuingOverflow.description: The number of calls that overflowed from the queue, where queue overflow refers to calls exceeding the queue capacity while waiting in the IVR queue.

CallsAbandonedInRing.description: Number of calls abandoned during ringing, which refers to the quantity of calls where the customer hung up while the agent's phone was ringing.

AverageWorkTime.description: Average post-processing time, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsHandled.

CallsQueued.description: Number of calls entering the queue. If a single call enters the queue multiple times, it is counted once.

AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description: Average ring-time abandon duration, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalAbandonedInRingTime / CallsAbandonedInRing.

SatisfactionIndex.description: \[responses\_200\_schema\_properties\_Data\_properties\_Inbound\_properties\_CallsQueuingOverflow\_type]integer

CallsAbandoned.description: Total number of abandoned calls. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandonedInIVR + CallsAbandonedInQueue + CallsAbandonedInRing.

MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description: Maximum queue abandonment duration, in seconds.

CallsAbandonedInVoiceNavigator.description: Number of calls abandoned in the Intelligent Voice Navigator module.

CallsQueuingTimeout.description: Number of calls that timed out during the queuing phase.

ServiceLevel20.description: Service level within 20 seconds: number of calls with wait time less than or equal to 20 seconds divided by CallsQueued.

MaxHoldTime.description: Maximum hold time, in seconds.

CallsForwardToOutsideNumber.description: Number of calls forwarded to an external number.

SatisfactionRate.description: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Number of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses.

AverageHoldTime.description: Average call hold duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold.

CallsAbandonedInQueue.description: Number of calls abandoned in queue, which refers to the number of calls where the customer hung up while waiting in the queue after the call entered the queue.

TotalAbandonedInQueueTime.description: Total queue abandon time, in seconds.

CallsCausedIVRException.description: Number of calls that caused IVR exceptions.

CallsToVoicemail.description: The number of calls routed to voicemail.

TotalMessagesSent.description: Total number of messages sent in chat sessions.

AverageRingTime.description: Average ring time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged.

MaxWorkTime.description: Maximum post-processing time per call, in seconds.

AverageWorkTime.description: Average post-processing time per call, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsDialed.

SatisfactionIndex.description: Satisfaction Index, which is the average of the satisfaction keypress digits (single-digit numbers).

CallsRinged.description: Number of calls that rang for agents. If a single call is assigned to multiple agents and rings for each, it is counted as one.

CallsBlindTransferred.description: Number of blind transfers, which refers to the quantity of calls that underwent blind transfer. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one.

AnswerRate.description: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed. (Because the answering event and the acknowledgement event may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases.)

MaxHoldTime.description: Maximum call hold duration, in seconds.

AverageTalkTime.description: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsAnswered.

SatisfactionRate.description: Satisfaction Rate. Calculation Formula: Number of responses marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses.

CallsAttendedTransferred.description: Number of attended transfers, which refers to the quantity of calls that underwent attended transfer. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one.

CallsHold.description: Hold Count, which is the number of calls that were placed on hold. If a single call was put on hold multiple times, it is counted as one.

AverageHoldTime.description: Average hold duration, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold.

AverageDialingTime.description: Average Dial-up Time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalDialingTime / CallsDialed.

TotalLoggedInTime.description: Total logon duration, in seconds. Exclude break time.

OccupancyRate.description: Agent occupancy rate. Calculation Formula: (TotalWorkTime + TotalTalkTime) / TotalLoggedInTime.

MaxHoldTime.description: Maximum call hold duration, in seconds.

MaxWorkTime.description: Maximum post-processing time per call, in seconds.

AverageBreakTime.description: Average break duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalBreakTime / Count of breaks. The count of breaks is not an exposed API field.

SatisfactionRate.description: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Count of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses.

MaxBreakTime.description: Maximum short break duration, in seconds.

AverageWorkTime.description: Average post-processing time per call, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / TotalCalls.

AverageTalkTime.description: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / (CallsAnswered + CallsHandled).

SatisfactionIndex.description: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the satisfaction keypress digits (single-digit numbers).

AverageReadyTime.description: Average ready duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalReadyTime / Count of ready events. The count of ready events is not currently exposed externally.

AverageHoldTime.description: Average call hold duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / (InboundCallsHold + OutboundCallsHold).

TotalCalls.description: Total call volume. Calculation Formula: CallsOffered + CallsDialed.

schema.description: The agent ID initiating the consultation transfer.
Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value.

The queuing priority when transferring to a skill group queue. Valid values range from 0 to 9, where 0 is the highest priority and 9 is the lowest.
The policy name for agent assignment when transferring to a skill group queue.
The policy parameters for agent assignment when transferring to a skill group queue.

The destination type for the transfer. Valid values are AGENT, SKILL\_GROUP, and EXTERNAL. If this parameter is not provided, the system determines the destination type based on the format of the target number. If inaccurate detection occurs, explicitly specify this parameter.

The call assignment type. Valid values are Automatic or Manual. If this parameter is empty, the default value is Automatic, which is also the current system's default behavior. When Manual is selected, you must invoke APIs such as ClaimCall to assign the call to a specific agent.
Ingest endpoint data, primarily used for extension requirements. Regular users do not need to concern themselves with this.

HandleRate.description: Acknowledgement rate. Calculation Formula: CallsHandled / CallsOffered (because acknowledgement events and assign events may fall into different Time Ranges, the Result may exceed 100% in certain cases).

AnswerRate.description: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed. (Because management events for answering and acknowledgement may fall into different Time Ranges, the Result may exceed 100% in some cases.)

AverageTalkTime.description: Average talk time, in seconds.

AverageWorkTime.description: Average post-processing duration, in seconds.

End Time, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. The default value is the current time. CallsOverflow.description: Overflow count, which is the number of calls that overflowed from a queue (skill group). If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each overflow is counted separately.

CallsAbandonedInRing.description: Ring abandonment count, which refers to the number of calls abandoned by customers while ringing to an agent.

CallsHandled.description: Acknowledgement count, which is the number of times agents answered calls. For a single call that enters a queue multiple times, if it is answered by multiple agents after one queue entry, it is counted as one.

TotalAbandonedInRingTime.description: Total ringing abandonment duration, in seconds.

CallsAttendedTransferOut.description: Attended transfer-out count, which refers to the number of calls transferred from this skill group to another skill group for consultation. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted.

AverageWaitTime.description: Average wait time, which is the average duration a caller waits before an agent answers the call. Calculation Formula: TotalWaitTime / CallsHandled.

TotalHoldTime.description: Total call hold time, in seconds.

AverageWorkTime.description: Average post-processing duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsHandled.

CallsQueued.description: Number of inbound calls entering a queue (skill group). If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each entry is counted separately.

CallsBlindTransferIn.description: Quantity of blind transfer-in calls, which refers to the number of calls directly transferred into this skill group from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed into multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed into. If a single call is transferred multiple times from other skill groups into this skill group, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below.

SatisfactionIndex.description: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the satisfaction rating digits (single-digit numbers) entered by callers.

AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description: Average ringing abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInRingTime / CallsAbandonedInRing.

AverageAbandonTime.description: Average abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonTime / CallsAbandoned.

CallsRinged.description: Number of calls that rang to agents. Each time a call enters the queue and is assigned to multiple agents, resulting in ringing, it is counted as one occurrence.

CallsBlindTransferOut.description: Quantity of blind transfer-out calls, which refers to the number of calls directly transferred out from this skill group to other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted.

CallsAttendedTransferIn.description: Attended transfer-in count, which is the number of calls transferred to this skill group via attended transfers initiated from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent signs in to multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed in to. If a single call is transferred from another skill group to this skill group multiple times, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below.

CallsAbandoned.description: Abandoned call quantity. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandonedInQueue + CallsAbandonedInRing.

MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description: Maximum queue abandonment duration, in seconds.

AbandonRate.description: Abandon rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandoned / CallsOffered (because management events related to abandonment and assignment may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases).

CallsOffered.description: Assigned call volume, which is the number of calls assigned to this skill group, including calls assigned through queues and calls assigned via transfers (consultation transfers and direct transfers). Calculation formula: CallsQueued + CallsBlindTransferIn + CallsAttendedTransferIn.

MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description: Maximum ring abandonment duration, in seconds.

AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description: Average abandoned-in-queue duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInQueueTime / CallsAbandonedInQueue.

ServiceLevel20.description: Service level within 20 seconds: the number of calls with waiting time less than or equal to 20 seconds divided by CallsQueued.

MaxHoldTime.description: Maximum hold duration, in seconds.

SatisfactionRate.description: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Number of evaluations marked as satisfied divided by the count of satisfaction survey responses.

AverageTalkTime.description: Average talk duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsHandled.

CallsHold.description: Hold count, which is the number of times calls were placed on hold. If a single call enters the queue and is placed on hold multiple times, it is counted as one.

HandleRate.description: Acknowledgement rate. Calculation Formula: CallsHandled / CallsOffered (because acknowledgement events and assignment events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases).

CallsTimeout.description: Timeout count, which is the number of calls that timed out in a queue (skill group). If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each timeout is counted separately.

AverageHoldTime.description: Average hold time during calls, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold.

ListRamUsers.summary: You can call the ListRamUsers operation to retrieve a list of Resource Access Management (RAM) users that have not been imported into a specified instance.
ListRamUsers.description: A Resource Access Management (RAM) user can be imported as an agent into multiple instances. However, an agent can only be linked to one RAM account. When you create an agent in an instance, a RAM account is also created. If you want to create a new instance without creating redundant RAM accounts, you can call the ListRamUsers operation. This operation retrieves a list of RAM users that have not yet been imported into the instance. You can then call the import operation to add these existing RAM users to the new instance. This method helps you avoid creating unnecessary RAM accounts and prevents resource waste.

StartPredictiveCall.title: Initiate a predictive outbound call
StartPredictiveCall.description:
In addition to supporting agents initiating outbound calls from the agent Workbench, Cloud Call Center also enables your Operational System backend to initiate outbound calls and transfer the call to an agent after it is answered. This allows you to seamlessly embed Cloud Call Center features into your Business Process.
For example, your Customer can enter their phone number on your WeChat Official Account and click a button to inquire about a product. Your backend system then invokes this API to call the Customer’s Phone. After the call is connected, the system plays back the message: “We have received your inquiry about our product via the Official Account. We are now connecting you to an advisor. Please wait.” The call is then transferred to an appropriate agent.
Compared with the DialEX API in version 1.0, this API offers greater flexibility in configuration. In addition to customizing the IVR for transfer-in, you can also pass custom parameters, which can be played back by voice within the IVR to support notification scenarios.

schema.description: The ID of the object to which the configuration information belongs.
The type of the object to which the configuration information belongs.

A list of configuration items in the format of a JSON array string. Each array element is an object with two fields: name and value. The name field specifies the name of the configuration item, and the value field specifies its value. Configuration item names can be system-defined or custom. System-defined items, such as whether to allow agents to hang up, auto-answer calls, or the no-answer timeout, have fixed names but customizable values. You can also add custom configuration items as needed.

enumValueTitles.AllowAudioDownload: Specifies whether to allow agents to download recordings. Valid values: 0 (No), 1 (Yes).
enumValueTitles.RecordingStorageSetting: The recording storage configuration for the instance.
enumValueTitles.AllowChooseSignedSkillGroup: Specifies whether agents must manually select skill groups to sign in to before going online. Valid values: 0 (Agents are automatically signed in to all their assigned skill groups), 1 (Agents manually select the skill groups to sign in to).
enumValueTitles.AgentRingingTimeoutSeconds: The no-answer timeout duration for an agent. The value must be between 5 and 90. Unit: seconds.
enumValueTitles.ShowCalledID: The caller ID display for incoming calls to an agent. Valid values: -1 (Hide the full number), 0 (Hide part of the number), 1 (Show the full number).
enumValueTitles.ShowCalleeID: The callee ID display for outgoing calls from an agent. Valid values: -1 (Hide the full number), 0 (Hide part of the number), 1 (Show the full number).
enumValueTitles.AllowHangup: The hang-up policy for incoming calls to an agent. Valid values: 0 (Agents cannot hang up), 1 (Agents can hang up).
enumValueTitles.AutoAnswerCall: The answering mode for incoming calls to an agent. Valid values: -1 (Manual answer), n (Auto-answer after n seconds of ringing).
